query: SELECT codigoItem, DATE_FORMAT(SUBSTRING(dataEmissao, 1, 10), '%Y-%m') as yearMonth, COALESCE(SUM(quantidade), 0) as totalQty FROM sales_orders WHERE codigoItem IN ('00046', '00047', '00050') AND estadoItem IN ('Faturado', 'Faturado parcial', 'Faturado c/ entrega futura') AND SUBSTRING(dataEmissao, 1, 10) >= '2026-02-01' AND SUBSTRING(dataEmissao, 1, 10) < '2026-05-01' GROUP BY codigoItem, DATE_FORMAT(SUBSTRING(dataEmissao, 1, 10), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY yearMonth, codigoItem;
